comparison.objective: Unload two supported books, place both flat, and park the supporting hand; candidate finishes four installed threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Book task tests support transfer and careful planar placement; candidate tests recessed alignment, bimanual tool use, controlled impact, and tiny-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both books must be preserved and flat, with no required sequence; candidate requires four physical fractures and contained fragments with coils and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Support unloading and flat placement test a different manipulation outcome from controlled component fracture and debris recovery.
